questionText: Which exact hours are the high-volume windows Alex G will trade?
reason: This source finally makes session timing an explicit, load-bearing rule - and the windows themselves are shown only as coloured bands on an on-screen session map, never spoken. Sydney, London and New York are named; no times are given. The gap recorded since source #2 ('trading at the right times') and source #4 ('the proper session') is now DOWNGRADED but NOT CLOSED: the rule exists and is prescriptive, but its parameters remain unstated. MOGO must not supply session hours - TJR's sessions are evidenced for TJR only.
